narrative.overview:
Fate Collector presents advice like a specimen catalog. Align names, tiers and reward values for comparison, and keep the source capture nearby so players can inspect unfamiliar rewards.

Mineral Depth uses petrol and mint. Light Trail pairs an olive shell with pale neutral work surfaces and violet. Both use the same spacing, hierarchy and interactions.
keyCharacteristics: One decision surface with adjacent evidence
Quiet navigation and compact, ruled comparison rows
Uncertainty communicated in words and color

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Reserve green for supported advice, amber for provisional results or confirmation, and blue for review. Include the state in text.

rules.name: The Functional Elevation Rule
rules.body: Lift the decision, import and journal surfaces and the overlays. Group nested detail with tone, spacing and dividers.

dos: Do keep the next action and its supporting evidence easy to find.
Do expose focus, pressed state and pending or saved status in both themes.
Do use real captures and game terms when showing evidence.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate confidence, selection or review status.
Don't add decorative game artwork or invented observations.
